claims.claim: packc commands are compile, compile-prompt, validate, inspect, version, help, completion
validation uses the embedded PromptPack schema by default; PROMPTKIT_SCHEMA_SOURCE local/remote/path overrides
packc compile-prompt flags -p/--prompt and -o/--output, both required; --pack-version optional
packc compile flags: -c/--config (default config.arena.yaml), -o/--output (default <id>.pack.json), --id (default current folder name sanitized), --pack-version (default v1.0.0)
validate prints 'Validating pack', '✓ Schema validation passed', warnings, '✓ Pack structure is valid'; errors exit 1
packc compile sets name=id, version from --pack-version (default v1.0.0), description 'Pack containing N prompts', $schema latest URL, compilation block
each prompt gets the default template/provider/validator pipeline
PromptPack schema requires id, name, version, template_engine, prompts; optional $schema, description, fragments, tools, metadata, compilation, evals, workflow, agents, skills, compositions, requires
